**Finding: compliant** (no redline proposed).

§ 22 of the Copperleaf agreement sits at the **preferred** position on all material audit terms:

| Term | Playbook preferred | Document (§ 22) |
|---|---|---|
| Frequency | Once per 12 months | Once in any twelve-month period ✓ |
| Notice | 30 days' written | Thirty days' prior written ✓ |
| Timing/manner | Business hours | Normal business hours, no unreasonable disruption ✓ |
| Auditor | Independent, confidentiality-bound | Same, plus off-site where practicable ✓ |
| Cost | Vendor, unless underpayment >5% | Vendor, unless underpayment >5% ✓ |
| System access | None | Express bar on direct system access, unrelated Customer Data, privileged material, third-party confidential info ✓ |

I confirmed § 22 is the *only* right of this kind — a document-wide search for audit, inspect, verify, monitor, remote access and telemetry turned up no parallel monitoring or self-verification right that could circumvent these limits (the only other hit was the "Customer Data" definition's telemetry carve-out, which is unrelated to audit).

§ 22.3 is additionally favourable to us: audit findings are our Confidential Information usable only to enforce the Agreement, we get a copy of the final report, and paying a shortfall closes out the audited quantity issue absent fraud or demonstrable error. Nothing to flag.
